guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile failed to build due to an issue with the version of Node.js. Specifically, the error message indicates that the version of Node.js installed by the Dockerfile (v18.20.8) is incompatible with the version required by npm@12.2.0. According to the error message, npm@12.2.0 requires Node.js version ^22.22.2, ^24.15.0, or >=26.0.0. To fix this:

1. Update the Node.js installation to a compatible version. Replace the line in the Dockerfile that installs Node.js with the following commands to install the latest LTS version of Node.js:

```
# Install Node.js (latest LTS version)
RUN curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.3/install.sh | bash \
    && . ~/.nvm/nvm.sh \
    && nvm install --lts \
    && nvm use --lts \
    && nvm alias default node \
    && npm install -g yarn \
    && npm install -g mocha
```

2. Ensure the Dockerfile does not run any tests (i.e., `npm run test`) during the build process. This step should be done in the eval script instead of the Dockerfile.
